scenes.display: Controllers, cameras and sensors in one live view.
scenes.text: Meet the IRIV Edge dashboard. One screen for every controller, camera and sensor in the city.

scenes.display: Every unit sits where it is installed.
scenes.text: Every IRIV unit sits on the map, exactly where it is installed. Here is the airport.

scenes.display: One button lists every IRIV unit.
scenes.text: One button lists every IRIV unit. Click a row and the map flies straight to it.

scenes.display: See what each unit is wired to, with live states.
scenes.text: Open a unit to see what it is wired to. Sensors, relays and the network, with their live states.

scenes.display: The automation rules it runs, live.
scenes.text: Below the wiring are the rules it runs. Each one shows its live reading, and whether it is firing.

scenes.display: Every change is published as an MQTT message.
scenes.text: Every change is published as an M Q T T message, with its topic and its payload.

scenes.display: Cut the network. See what keeps running.
scenes.text: Cut the network to see how a unit behaves offline. This PiControl keeps running its own rules and buffers its messages until the link returns.

scenes.display: AI cameras: the video stays on the device.
scenes.text: Edge A I units open with a live camera view. The video never leaves the device. Only the results are sent.

scenes.display: One video wall for the whole airport.
scenes.text: At the airport, the control centre brings cameras, flights, passengers and the car park onto one video wall.

scenes.display: Open the live demo and click any IRIV unit.
scenes.text: Open the live demo, press IRIV units, and click any unit. All readings in this film are simulated.
